title: Sota
text: 3. Pañcimāni bhikkhave indriyāni || katamāni pañca || || Saddhindriyam || pe || paññindriyaṃ || || 4. Yato kho bhikkhave ariyasāvako imesam pañcannam indriyānaṃ samudayañca atthagamañca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtam pajānāti [page 194] 194 Indriya-Saṃyuttam XLVIII.
